observations.behavior: Adds documentation and dependency declarations for an offline connectivity feature.
observations.code_quote: Chat pauses streams while offline. Task and history reads resume when the connection returns. When the connection returns or the app enters the foreground, chat resumes the same run with its saved cursor and transcript. The Reconnect button also restarts streams after the retry limit. Authentication, permission and missing-run errors prevent automatic recovery. Recovery does not resend messages, answers or run creation requests.
